description: This file is a PHP source code defining the CalendarController class, which manages calendar-related actions in the SuiteCRM system. It handles operations such as saving activities, quick editing, rescheduling, removing, resizing calendar events, and retrieving activities. The class interacts with other modules, utilities, and beans within the SuiteCRM ecosystem.

classes.name: CalendarController
classes.description: A controller class in SuiteCRM responsible for managing calendar actions such as save, quick edit, reschedule, remove, resize, and activity retrieval, integrating with other modules, beans, and utilities.

methods.name: action_saveactivity
methods.description: Handles saving of calendar activities, including recurrence handling, validation, and invoking the form base class to persist data.

methods.name: action_quickedit
methods.description: Prepares the view for quick editing of calendar entries.

methods.name: action_getUser
methods.description: Fetches and outputs user information based on a provided record ID.

methods.name: action_reschedule
methods.description: Reschedules calendar activities, typically via drag-and-drop UI, with validation for date constraints.

methods.name: action_remove
methods.description: Removes (deletes) calendar activities, with optional cascade for recurring events.

methods.name: action_resize
methods.description: Handles resizing of calendar events, persists changes.

methods.name: retrieveCurrentBean
methods.description: Retrieves the current activity bean, checks ACL permissions for the specified action, and prepares it for operations.

methods.name: action_getActivities
methods.description: Retrieves and loads activities for display in the calendar, considering user permissions and shared calendars.
